title: Research: selected adjacent centre-owner census
body:
## Result

This package closes a bounded direct-owner witness question for the selected PR1094 schedule. It checks all 143 adjacent call pairs in the pinned 144-call schedule.

- 81 adjacent pairs have the same orientation; all have disjoint full 112-row target panels.
- Those 81 pairs share no physical owner ID among the eight centre source rows.
- Nine pairs have equal charts in all eight source slots, while their physical owner IDs remain distinct.
- No pair satisfies identical ordered owner/chart source maps, compatible orientation, and disjoint full target panels.

The result is scoped to direct owner identity in this fixed adjacent-pair domain. It says nothing about aliases, copied values, linear maps between owners, nonadjacent calls, or changed schedules. It establishes no supplier admission, paid-moment saving, conditional bound, or kappa.

## Assignment and pins

- Track: recursive-interfaces; seed `01fcb18657c95161de8ab0f13b632878`; task `persistent-boundary`, refined.
- Priority revision: 3; base: `0b1cccf86e2f5132ed286a26ef0a681a495740ea`.
- Selected-result SHA-256: `10b9e340fd8e354a37a0c4813c90e5de1dd42044b5f6aca4a3fc5a42b685fa32`.
- Package: `research/selected-centre-adjacent-pair-seed01fcb1/`.
- The package pins the selected review, source manifest, assembly certificate, integration receipt, replay archive, and predecessor heads in `SOURCES.json`, `TASK.json`, and `verify.py`.

The predecessor mechanisms are PR1708 (forward two-panel centre fanout), PR1748 (reverse shared-centre return and precision guard), and PR1791 (actual-profile overhead budget). This contribution supplies the missing bounded schedule census for direct owner/chart identity. PR1522's dyadic shared queries and PR1826's C5 echo were also checked; they use different objects.

## Reproduce

The exact census verifier passed locally with:

```sh
python3 -I -O -B research/selected-centre-adjacent-pair-seed01fcb1/verify.py
```

It reports `PASS_SELECTED_ADJACENT_OWNER_CENSUS`; one positive and five negative controls pass. Package metadata and source pins pass with:

```sh
python3 scripts/research_package.py --package research/selected-centre-adjacent-pair-seed01fcb1 --check-only
```

The registered replay requires Python 3.12, unavailable in the local environment; the PR workflow is expected to run the manifest replay under its pinned interpreter. No full selected-frontier cold replay was run for this bounded census.

## Cost and limits

Sharing the rank-eight centre paths would save 32 paid-mass units per call. PR1791 leaves about 30.5–30.8 units per call for full bit-limited gain and strictly less than 32 for any gain. The census finds no direct shared owner boundary; any owner transport or other mechanism remains unimplemented and unpriced, alongside precision, frame, restoration, hosting, and interface charges.

Claim and handoff: Discussion #1516, comment 18922503. Substantial OpenAI Codex assistance was used in source inspection, implementation, and verification.
